correctness.rationale: Independent Gaussian row projections of b and Ab have correlation ρ=(bᵀAb)/(||b||||Ab||), producing two normal/chi ratios T_s/√s via Gaussian regression. Harmonic extraction is the reciprocal after reversing roles. Both signs equal the sign of (Sb)ᵀ(SAb). The Kantorovich spectral-angle bound ρ≥2√K/(K+1) is attained by A=diag(1,K) and the displayed vector. Student beta CDF yields p_s(K), fixed-K beta endpoint asymptotics and high-K CLT. For X=ρ+(σ/√s)T_s, f_X(0)=Γ((s+1)/2)σ^s/(√πΓ(s/2))>0, so P(α/X>t)~α f_X(0)/t on each side and positive/negative means diverge; eigenvectors give the deterministic exception. Analytic proof valid for all s≥1; Monte Carlo alone is not invoked.
